name: cdist dependency graph
description: Dependency view of a host's last cdist run, read from cache; nothing is configured.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host that has a cached cdist run.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: tree = layered levels, top level runs first/parallel; types = per-type network; objects = per-object network.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: Tree view: tb = levels top-to-bottom (default); lr = levels left-to-right.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Limit to these object types. Empty = all types.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Object to centre on, e.g. __file/etc/motd. Empty = whole graph.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: With a focus: up = its dependencies, down = its dependents.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Tree view: dependents = objects that depend on something first (default); primitives = objects that depend on nothing first.

parameters.name: no collapse
parameters.description: Tree view: show every object, do not merge pass-through chains (usually far too large).
